name: mesflow-m910-kiosk-provisioner
trust_boundary: USB MAC and LAN health MAC exact match
fixed local ESP health endpoint with redirects refused
LAN health is unauthenticated HTTP and requires a physically trusted private network
root-owned 0600 identity manifest and credential files
server-side UUID allowlist and one-time proof claim
limitations: USB HELLO MAC and UUID are not authenticated
a compromised or physically accessible M910 can observe USB configuration
LAN health fields are unauthenticated and do not attest firmware cryptographically
bundle contains no credentials, live config, or device identity
